posts.title: Getting Back To It
posts.description: Where have I been? It's been a busy year, personally and professionally. To be honest I feel like I've been running on fumes for a while, and burnout just caught up to me. Between life and my day job, I simply did not have the time or inclination to spend more time i.e. nights and weekends sitting at my desk and brute forcing learning GML and pixel art. posts.title: Welcome to CHUSOFT!
posts.description: Hi, my name is Keegan Chua! If you stumbled on this, congratulations. For the time being I'm going to keep this venture relatively low-key. I'm calling it CHUSOFT , which is very very clever wordplay combining my last name Chua + Software . Please clap. I. What is this? TL;DR I'm making a game.
